description: Find LIVE-BOOKABLE accommodation operators near a location via the live booking partner (real-time inventory). Use this when the user wants to actually BOOK and needs live availability/pricing — this is DIFFERENT from search_campsites (our own directory). Returns operator_id values that the other bk_ tools need. Prefer this when the user says things like 'book', 'reserve', 'is it available', or asks for real prices for specific dates.
name: bk_search_operators
title: Search bookable caravan parks
